name: Zettai Nakadashi☆Haramase Gakuen
original_name: 絶対中出し☆孕ませ学園
source:
The protagonist of the heir of a wealthy family, always gets what he wants.

But one thing is his wish, he could not realize -
he wanted to fertilize once a dozen girls and women.

Do this for the sake of his family bought the ideas private academy for girls
and put up a hero there pupil on exclusive rights. Under the contract,
he could perform with pupils and teachers any sexual act;
in turn, the girls were forbidden to deny him this,
another huge debt burden will fall on the shoulders of the academy.

With the support of faithful servant Mary hero begins the path to the realization of his dream.
